translations.web: For as through the one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one, many will be made righteous.
translations.bsb: For just as through the disobedience of the one man the many were made sinners, so also through the obedience of the one man the many will be made righteous.
translations.kjv: For as by one man's disobedience many were made sinners, so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous.
translations.asv: For as through the one man's disobedience the many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one shall the many be made righteous.
